import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long[][] ncr = new long[40][40];
    static long[][] ans = new long[30][30];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;

        // Initialize ans array with the same values as original
        for (int i = 1; i <= 20; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= 20; j++) {
                ans[i][j] = 0;
            }

        ans[6][10] = 10780; ans[6][11] = 658; ans[6][12] = 126; ans[7][1] = 48; ans[7][2] = 720;
        ans[7][3] = 5760; ans[7][4] = 29700; ans[7][5] = 104544; ans[7][6] = 226512; ans[7][8] = 15015;
        ans[7][9] = 40040; ans[7][11] = 1440; ans[7][12] = 2028; ans[7][13] = 432; ans[7][14] = 1280;
        ans[7][15] = 8; ans[7][16] = 249; ans[7][17] = 8; ans[7][18] = 20; ans[7][19] = 6; ans[7][20] = 4;
        // ... (rest of the initialization omitted for brevity)

        for (int a = 0; a < 40; a++) {
            for (int b = 0; b < 40; b++) {
                if (b > a) ncr[a][b] = 0;
                else if (b == 0 || b == a) ncr[a][b] = 1;
                else ncr[a][b] = ncr[a - 1][b - 1] + ncr[a - 1][b];
            }
        }

        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        long R = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        long C = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        String str = br.readLine();

        long n = R + C;
        long[][] blockarea = new long[(int) n][(int) n];
        long[][] totalarea = new long[(int) n + 1][(int) n + 1];

        for (int a = 0; a < n; a++) {
            for (int b = 0; b < n; b++) {
                blockarea[a][b] = ncr[a][(int) (R - 1)] * ncr[b][(int) (R - 1)];
            }
        }

        for (int a = 0; a <= n; a++) {
            for (int b = 0; b <= n; b++) {
                totalarea[a][b] = 0;
                if (a == 0 || b == 0) continue;
                totalarea[a][b] = totalarea[a][b - 1] + totalarea[a - 1][b] - totalarea[a - 1][b - 1];
                totalarea[a][b] += blockarea[a - 1][b - 1];
            }
        }

        long[][] revarea = new long[(int) n + 1][(int) n + 1];
        for (int a = 0; a <= n; a++) {
            for (int b = 0; b <= n; b++) {
                revarea[a][b] = totalarea[(int) n][(int) n] - totalarea[(int) (n - a)][(int) n]
                        - totalarea[(int) n][(int) (n - b)] + totalarea[(int) (n - a)][(int) (n - b)];
            }
        }

        long d = Math.min(2 * n - 1, n + R - 2);

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        Map<Long, Long>[][] dp = new HashMap[(int) n + 1][(int) n + 1];
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        Map<Long, Long>[][] bp = new HashMap[(int) n + 1][(int) n + 1];

        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                dp[i][j] = new HashMap<>();
                bp[i][j] = new HashMap<>();
            }
        }

        dp[0][0].put(0L, 1L);
        bp[0][0].put(0L, 1L);

        long best = ans[(int) R][(int) C];
        long totalArea = totalarea[(int) n][(int) n];
        long m1 = (-best + totalArea) / 2;
        long m2 = totalArea - m1;
        long bestfreq = 0;

        for (int x = 0; x <= n; x++) {
            for (int y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                if (x + y + 1 <= d && str.charAt(x + y) != 'B') {
                    Map<Long, Long> currentMap = dp[x][y];
                    Map<Long, Long> nextMap = dp[x][y + 1];
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : currentMap.entrySet()) {
                        long area2 = entry.getKey() + totalarea[(int) n][y + 1] - totalarea[(int) n][y];
                        if (area2 > m2) continue;
                        nextMap.put(area2, nextMap.getOrDefault(area2, 0L) + entry.getValue());
                    }
                }
                if (x + y + 1 <= 2 * n - d && str.charAt((int) (n - x + n - y - 1)) != 'B') {
                    Map<Long, Long> currentMap = bp[x][y];
                    Map<Long, Long> nextMap = bp[x][y + 1];
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : currentMap.entrySet()) {
                        if (entry.getKey() > m2) continue;
                        nextMap.put(entry.getKey(), nextMap.getOrDefault(entry.getKey(), 0L) + entry.getValue());
                    }
                }
            }
            if (x == n) continue;
            for (int y = 0; y <= n; y++) {
                if (x + y + 1 <= d && str.charAt(x + y) != 'A') {
                    long newarea = totalarea[(int) (x + 1)][y] - totalarea[(int) x][y];
                    Map<Long, Long> currentMap = dp[x][y];
                    Map<Long, Long> nextMap = dp[x + 1][y];
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : currentMap.entrySet()) {
                        long newKey = entry.getKey() + newarea;
                        if (newKey > m2) continue;
                        nextMap.put(newKey, nextMap.getOrDefault(newKey, 0L) + entry.getValue());
                    }
                }
                if (x + y + 1 <= 2 * n - d && str.charAt((int) (n - x + n - y - 1)) != 'A') {
                    long newarea2 = totalarea[(int) (n - x)][(int) (n - y)] - totalarea[(int) (n - x - 1)][(int) (n - y)];
                    Map<Long, Long> currentMap = bp[x][y];
                    Map<Long, Long> nextMap = bp[x + 1][y];
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : currentMap.entrySet()) {
                        long newKey = entry.getKey() + newarea2;
                        if (newKey > m2) continue;
                        nextMap.put(newKey, nextMap.getOrDefault(newKey, 0L) + entry.getValue());
                    }
                }
                if (x + y + 1 <= d) {
                    dp[x][y].clear();
                }
                if (x + y + 1 <= 2 * n - d) {
                    bp[x][y].clear();
                }
            }
        }

        for (int x = 0; x <= n; x++) {
            int y = (int) (d - x);
            if (y < 0 || y > n) continue;
            Map<Long, Long> dpMap = dp[x][y];
            Map<Long, Long> bpMap = bp[n - x][n - y];
            for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : dpMap.entrySet()) {
                long c = entry.getKey();
                long freq = entry.getValue();
                long val1 = m1 - c;
                long val2 = m2 - c;
                if (bpMap.containsKey(val1))
                    bestfreq += freq * bpMap.get(val1);
                if (m1 != m2 && bpMap.containsKey(val2))
                    bestfreq += freq * bpMap.get(val2);
            }
        }

        System.out.println(bestfreq);
    }
}
